dimensions_nm.40S_definition: 18S rRNA + 40S ribosomal proteins (incl. RACK1, eL41, the ubiquitin moiety of eS31) as modelled in this entry
dimensions_nm.40S_bbox_note: axis-aligned over all modelled non-H atoms of the 40S core
dimensions_nm.40S_max_diameter_note: largest distance between any two 40S backbone trace atoms (18S P, protein CA); all-atom extent is ~0.5 nm larger
dimensions_nm.40S_principal_axis_note: extents along the 40S core's own principal axes, over the backbone trace atoms (same point set as 40S_max_diameter_nm); orientation-independent, so the axis-aligned all-atom bbox above is larger

caveats: Coordinates are decimated backbone traces, not full atomic detail.
The mRNA is the synthetic construct used in vitro by the depositors.

In this entry (48S-1, open codon-scanning state) the start codon is NOT in the P site: author residues 18/19 are the A and U of the ACCACC-AUG-G start codon and sit at the 3' (entry-channel) edge of the resolved path.
Residue numbering is the depositors' construct numbering, not AUG-relative; 0 is skipped.

surface_spheres.note: one sphere per up to 10 consecutive residues of 18S rRNA + 40S proteins; centre = mean of the window's non-H atoms, radius = RMS atom spread + 3.0 A padding. Draw as an InstancedMesh of low-poly spheres for a cheap blob.

mrna_channel.direction_note: The 40S translocates 5'->3', so mRNA is drawn IN at its downstream (3') end through the entry channel and pushed OUT at its upstream (5') end through the exit channel.

p_site_geometric.note: mRNA residue whose P atom is closest to a tRNAi anticodon (res 34-36) P atom; in this open scanning state the codon-anticodon duplex is NOT formed, so this is a geometric proxy only

start_codon_in_resolved_path.note: first AUG inside the resolved stretch, author numbering

entry_edge_offset_from_p_site_nt.note: nt from the geometric P-site residue to the 3'-most modelled nucleotide (the leading/entry edge of the 40S). Compare the published toeprint leading edge of +16 to +18 nt (Pisareva & Pisarev 2016, Nucleic Acids Res 44:4252, PMID 27067542).

parts_note: flat point-cloud view of `geometry`, for generic renderers; 40S core points are [x,y,z,radius] surface spheres, the rest are [x,y,z] backbone trace atoms. Angstroms, same frame.
channel_path_note: mRNA phosphate path 5'->3', Angstroms; same data as geometry.mrna_channel.path_xyz_5to3_A
